Who are we? 
 We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 225,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind that work, our people, are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence on a regular basis.
 Job description 
Execute patch deployment and vulnerability remediation activities across supported infrastructure and applications, ensuring completion within defined SLA timelines.
Investigate and resolve routine patching issues.
Support patch compliance and cyber hygiene objectives by monitoring assigned remediation tickets, tracking overdue vulnerabilities, and following established governance processes.
Maintain accurate operational records and reporting, updating remediation status, documenting outcomes, and providing progress updates to stakeholders.
Contribute to process improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues, work on automation and enhancements, and maintaining patching procedures and knowledge documentation.
 Skills 
Years of exp: Min 5 years
 Patch Management, Vulnerability Management, IT Operations, Incident Investigation, Troubleshooting, SLA Management, Compliance Management, Cyber Security Operations, Ticket Management, Governance & Controls, Operational Reporting, Technical Documentation, Process Improvement, Automation, Stakeholder Management.
 What do we offer? 
25 holiday days per year.
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will be benefitting either of a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Reimbursement for eyeglasses – max 1500 RON to be claimed every 3 years.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
